title: California Probate Code section 8481 - When a personal representative's bond is not required
claims: Section 8481(a) provides that a bond is not required where the will waives the requirement of a bond, or where all beneficiaries waive the requirement in writing and the written waivers are attached to the petition for appointment, the second case not applying if the will requires a bond.

Section 8481(b) provides that, notwithstanding a waiver of bond by the will or by all the beneficiaries, on petition of any interested person or on its own motion, the court may for good cause require that a bond be given, either before or after issuance of letters.
